name: lever one leg extension
description: A machine leg extension done one leg at a time. It isolates the quads and helps even out strength between sides.
instructions: Sit on the machine and adjust the pad so it rests on your lower shin.
Set one foot under the pad and keep the other foot on the floor or footrest.
Extend your working leg until it is almost straight.
Squeeze your quad at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
